items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) and S Jalen Pitre will not travel to London; ruled OUT vs Jaguars. Tank Dell (knee) also OUT.
items.implication: Full RB workload to backup (Marks handled 98% snaps prior).
items.opportunity: RB2/flex upside for Texans backup RB in London game.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely pending treatment (likely blood thinners). Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Clot movement after playing through it in London; health priority.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for PHI offense; stream McKee or pivot.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks if active.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return (shoulder) in TNF vs SEA, then returned to game.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects ROS.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle this week on usage/matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP second straight day; Rashee Rice (hamstring) DNP again; DJ Moore (shoulder) DNP second day; Jeremiyah Love (ankle) DNP second day.
items.opportunity: If out: Huntley/Likely/Flowers for BAL; Worthy/others KC; backups ARI/BUF.

items.text: Eagles: Saquon Barkley no practice again (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.implication: Barkley questionable at best for Week 6; Smith trending up.
items.opportunity: If Barkley out, more work for backups; Smith target boost with Hurts out.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) ruled OUT, will not travel to London vs Jaguars along with Montgomery and Pitre.
items.implication: Nico Collins and others elevated in target share.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4. Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers; season-high 36% target share recently, even higher without Deebo.
items.why: Elite matchup + usage spike with Deebo out multi-week.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI elite usage), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) with Henderson multi-week out (prior 85% snaps/23 touches).
items.why: Volume + soft run defenses; Henderson high-ankle multi-week.
items.implication: RB1/2 range for Stevenson/Kyren; London bankable.

items.text: Patriots: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week high-ankle. When inactive W1, Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches; 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches since 2024.
items.implication: Stevenson borderline RB1 while Henderson out.

items.text: Breece Hall remains week-to-week, no practice. RB snaps since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Nwangwu 0.
items.why: Clear hierarchy in snaps without Hall.
items.implication: Allen is the clear starter/handcuff with high snap share.
items.opportunity: Near-every-down role for Allen while Hall out.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant again (hamstring), on track to start. 49ers opened IR practice window for WR Christian Kirk (calf).
items.implication: Caleb likely active; Kirk multi-week ramp possible.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; contenders with RB need should call. Worth risk of year too early.
items.implication: Potential mid-season trade candidate; monitor value.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA tough pass D), Justin Herbert (low total). Waddle yards concentrated in one game.
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB play, concentrated production.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (rookie) expected back to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; shot to play this weekend. Elite YPP offense (6.4) even without full Lamar.
items.why: Impressed in camp; role upside vs Bateman.
items.implication: Potential target earner in high-efficiency offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if active, especially if Lamar limited.
